_about: Real (company -> news) pairs for retrieval recall: the main news and the second factors of the 10 worked insight examples (docs/manual_analysis/insight-examples.md) plus the fuel-trader demo U_31505. News ids are rows of data/news/news.parquet. Picked by hand after reading the examples; the examples themselves were found news-first, so this set favours news a keyword search can reach.
